title: Checkout rewrite
text: The checkout module was a single massive activity with no clear ownership. Rebuilt it as an isolated feature module with its own navigation graph and a documented API surface, cutting the build time for checkout-only changes roughly in half.

title: Flaky test cleanup
text: Instrumented UI tests failed intermittently because they raced the network layer instead of waiting on it. Introduced a shared idling resource that let the whole suite wait on real responses, and flaky reruns dropped from most days to a handful a month.

title: Startup profiling
text: App cold start was slow and nobody had numbers to argue with. Traced the launch path with a profiler, found three blocking disk reads that did not need to happen before the first frame, and moved them off the critical path.

title: Onboarding talks
text: New hires kept re-learning the same lessons the hard way. Started a recurring internal talk series where senior engineers walked through real incidents and the reasoning behind the fixes, open to the whole team.

title: Cross-team feature ownership
text: Owned the Android side of three concurrent workstreams for different product managers: search ranking tweaks, a loyalty-points redemption flow, and delivery-address validation. Kept them on separate feature branches so none blocked the others.

title: Legacy module untangling
text: A shared utilities module had become a dumping ground with circular dependencies between unrelated features. Split it into small, single-purpose modules with explicit boundaries, which made each one independently testable for the first time.

title: Mentoring juniors
text: Paired weekly with two engineers who had just joined the team, reviewing their pull requests in depth and walking through debugging sessions together rather than leaving comments and moving on.

title: Reusable UI component
text: Three different screens had each built their own version of a collapsible list section, with subtly different animation timing and bugs. Consolidated them into one shared component with a single, tested animation curve.
